company_notes:
Background: TradeHaven runs low-latency market data enrichment and customer-facing order assistance. They are evaluating Redwood Dedicated to replace a mixed in-house + cloud inference fleet to get stronger latency guarantees and simplify ops.

Primary objectives for Dedicated POC:
- Firm throughput guarantees for peak market windows (defined as 1-hour spikes). Need headroom to sustain 2.5x baseline QPS during spikes.
- Latency SLO targets: p95 end-to-end <= 120ms for short inference (<64 tokens) on Dedicated; p99 <= 300ms. For reranking flows p95 <= 100ms.
- Deterministic tail behavior: require visibility into 99.9th percentile and per-instance tail correlations.
- Reserved GPU planning: propose initial reservation of 6x H100-equivalent GPUs with ability to burst +3 GPUs within 60s. Need a clear mapping from tokens/sec and concurrent sessions to GPU count.
- Cost profile: request per-month committed cost + per-token overage pricing and clear accounting for burst usage. Interested in Optimize recommendations (quantization, batching).

POC scope and test plan (agreed with SE):
- Representative prompt set delivered: drive://tradehaven/representative-prompts (includes market snippets, user intent, and short/long prompt mixes).
- Phase A (Lab bench): run microbench kernels on single GPU to map latency vs sequence length and batch size. Capture kernel timings and baseline throughput.
- Phase B (Load tests): deploy 4-GPU staging pool. Run mixed-load simulator: 60% short chat, 30% reranking, 10% embeddings. Ramp to 100% target QPS, hold 30 minutes, then spike to 250% for 15 minutes to evaluate autoscaling and burst. Capture requests/sec, tokens/sec, batch distribution, and tail latencies.
- Phase C (Soak): run 72-hour soak on 6-GPU pool at 75% steady QPS to observe memory stability, degradation, cache behavior, and KV cache warm/cold metrics. Check for OOMs or slowdowns.
- Phase D (Failure and recovery): simulate AZ outage and node preemption; validate automatic routing, failover to hosted fallback, and recovery time <5 minutes.

Metrics to capture / dashboards requested:
- End-to-end p50/p95/p99 per route and per-model (strings).
- GPU telemetry: utilization, memory pressure, GPU-side queue depth, kernel time percentiles.
- Serving telemetry: batch size histogram, batching latency, KV cache hit ratio, cold-start counts.
- Business signals: failed order enrichments, dropped sessions, and user-perceived latency samples.

Acceptance criteria for POC:
- p95 within SLOs for each traffic class for >=95% of measurement windows during soak.
- No unplanned OOMs; graceful degradation during spike test with fallback engaged.
- Burst to +3 GPUs within 60s and sustain p95 SLOs during simulated spike.
- Documentation of cost model and projected committed spend with overage calc.

SLA negotiation notes and commercial asks:
- TradeHaven requests explicit latency-based credits tied to rolling 30-day p95 breaches. Wants minimum 12-month price protection on committed units.
- Must define maintenance windows with 24-hr notice for anything disruptive.
- Requests detailed rollback and runbook access for incident response; wants read-only metrics access to their Redwood pool.

Security / compliance items:
- KMS integration must support BYOK and meet internal key rotation policy.
- Audit logs retention required 18 months for inference request traces.
- SSO via SAML2 with SCIM provisioning.

Recent timeline / interactions:
- 2026-01-15: initial inbound discovery from Head of Platform (Lara Kim). Diego assigned.
- 2026-02-01: technical kickoff with SE and SRE teams (ff_2026-02-01_intro).

- 2026-03-08: procurement requested full SLA draft and reservation quote.

Open questions / blockers:

- Legal needs template SLA with credit math and termination clauses.
- Infosec final review on BYOK KMS integration and log retention policy.

Next actions (ownerable):

- Diego to schedule 72-hr soak window with SRE for 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-18.

CRM notes: short bullets and follow-up rhythm. Prioritize H100 availability checks and procurement readiness. Watch for spike test results to validate burst policy.
